name: SDF-based Voxel Rendering
definition: Determines voxel visibility by evaluating a Signed Distance Function (SDF) at each voxel center; draws voxel if SDF <= 0.
summary: SDF-based Voxel Rendering determines voxel visibility by evaluating a Signed Distance Function at each grid center, differing from ray-marching by using discrete grid traversal rather than continuous density integration.
